pages.text: $(bold)Oil Deposit$(0)$(br2)Unlike metal ores, oil is not hosted in rock. It pools in $(thing)reservoirs$(0) at the very bottom of the world, just above bedrock (around Y -62 to -59), and is $(thing)extremely rare$(0) — expect long searches between finds.

You cannot prospect oil with a pick. Instead it is reached and drawn up with the appropriate $(thing)industrial machinery$(0) once your tech has advanced far enough.$(br2)See the $(l:tfc:materialism_tech/introduction)Tech Progression$(0) category for where oil fits in the road to industry.
